purpose: Define deterministic resolution of DWH addresses/queries into exact schema, instance, relation and field identities before data projection or mutation.

topics.name: DWH Schema Resolution
topics.purpose: Define deterministic resolution of DWH addresses/queries into exact schema, instance, relation and field identities before data projection or mutation.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant resolution step returns exact canonical identities.
semantics.order_rule: Resolution never depends on filesystem, declaration or discovery order.
semantics.alias_rule: Compatibility aliases may resolve only through explicit alias contracts.
semantics.output_rule: Resolved schema/field classification becomes input to output governance.
semantics.mutation_rule: Resolution alone is read-only and never mutates data.
semantics.trace_rule: Resolution trace can record exact path of canonical refs.

invariants.rule: DWH resolves and projects schemas/relations but never becomes the semantic owner of module domain models; local/relation bindings require exact declared identities and cannot be inferred from names or proximity.

hard_gates.condition: resolution order depends on file order

references.purpose: Resolution starts from common schema graph.
